models.summary: Runs fine on 16GB. It drew Japanese signs and a handwritten note correctly, and the JSON Layout put text and objects where I asked. Add the community image-editing LoRA (Moss-Image-Edit) and you can edit images with words: about 19 s at 512×512 and about 74 s at 1024×1024 (peak VRAM 11.4GB). Outfit swaps and rewriting a sign into Japanese were exact, but combining 2 reference images failed. On 2026-10-26 I also ran the same edit LoRA with a community node for ComfyUI 0.42's native MOSS (Moss-Image-Edit-Native): **about 4.1 s at 512×512 and about 14.8 s at 1024×1024**, roughly 5× faster (and system RAM grew by only about 3GB). At 1024×1024 the sign rewrite was also exact. A community LoRA that removes vertical banding in skies and fog (DeBand) barely changed the time, and only slightly reduced the stripes when boosted 5× to see them. On 2026-10-27 I also measured a community LoRA that teaches Base to color black-and-white manga (1024×1024 in about 43–52 s; the 「待って！」 in the speech bubble stayed intact) and one that draws transparent-background PNGs directly (non-commercial, about 2.2 s at 8 steps).
